rows.medi_said: uh, [speaking foreign language] is... Hold on. How do-- I don't know if it's like to...
rows.why: For 'did I hurt you' he reached for a preposition ('like to...'); the object rides on the verb: wajja3tek; Amal supplied it and he repeated وجّعتك (30:34).
ijer (leg) is feminine, so the verb is bitwajje3; he used masculine biywajje3; Amal named the rule ('is feminine') and he moved to بتوجعه (32:45).
